Plan the coffee pack Specify whole beans or ground coffee, roast-to-pack timing and target shelf life. Confirm whether a degassing valve is needed and request its specification separately. Check fill volume with your actual coffee; a nominal gram size does not establish the right pouch dimensions. Check the bottom gusset Confirm the bottom gusset, filled footprint and stability at the intended fill level. Keep artwork clear of the base fold and seals.
